checks: Public room creation returns distinct unguessable IDs, room-specific host and join links, scoped HttpOnly host cookies
Host/join pages render, exact room URLs are encoded in downloadable PNG QR, host status requires its cookie
Room creation alone leaves its clock empty; first join starts the timer, later joins preserve it, and scoped host extension adds exactly ten seconds
Direct room join needs name/profile only; no room code input
Foreign player credentials return401, foreign or absent host credentials return403
Room membership, ranks, private profiles and participant tokens remain isolated
First join automatically prepares a hidden shared challenge with frozen input; participant polling alone starts exactly one first round after the real 30 second deadline
Room A automatic start leaves room B on its independent extended countdown with no challenge or submissions
Confirmed demo judgment has one durable own pass event with a stable ID; replay and polling do not create another celebration
Actual JPEG bytes receive HTTP202 queued and become accepted with a visibly labelled demo verdict and ranking via polling
Identical image is refused within one room and allowed across rooms; final rankings and finishers remain separate

authentication.gameHostCookie: Only the newly created room host cookie is used for host operations and host-scoped state checks
authentication.gameParticipantBearer: Only newly registered room participant tokens are used for own-photo submissions and own-state synchronization
